name: parley
description: A native macOS workbench for supervised cross-vendor AI CLI collaboration.

scripts.test: node scripts/run-native-swift.mjs run --package-path native parley-native-checks && node --test scripts/github-security.test.mjs scripts/native-macos-package.test.mjs scripts/native-macos-release.test.mjs
scripts.test:conformance: node scripts/run-native-swift.mjs run --package-path native parley-conformance --runtime development
scripts.test:conformance:production: node scripts/run-native-swift.mjs run --package-path native parley-conformance --runtime production
scripts.test:conformance:plan: node scripts/run-native-swift.mjs run --package-path native parley-conformance --runtime development --dry-run
scripts.test:conformance:plan:production: node scripts/run-native-swift.mjs run --package-path native parley-conformance --runtime production --dry-run
